Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection procedures I1 required for combustion inspection after 12000 hrs operation
The medium EXH Gas, material 15 M03, 
Capacity 48.5 steam per hour
The 
first draft initiated by eng. Fouad Abd El Aziz Fayed, tested by eng. Khamis El 
Sherif, accepted by general manager eng. Samir Ebed Barghous, approved by eng. 
Mahmoud Saad Mahmoud Balbaa Mahmoudia PS head sector, and certified by eng. Mona 
Ahmed Al Sherqawy WDEPC inspection & quality 
control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
The qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area
Wear safety, healthy, shoes
Shut down the Boiler.
Disconnect the power supply & rack out the CB.
Put red tag on the Boiler.
The safety dep. must check the isolation and surrounding the work zone.
